sentences.en: I know a very good shampoo that takes seborrhea away.
sentences.zh: 我知道一种非常好的洗发水可以去除脂溢性皮炎。

sentences.en: I got some shampoo in my eyes and it stings.
sentences.zh: 我眼睛里进了些洗发水，有点刺痛。

sentences.en: I got some shampoo in my eyes and it burns.
sentences.zh: 我眼睛里进了些洗发水，感觉辣辣的。

senses.zh: 用洗发剂洗，洗(头发，地毯等)
